data.name: Dogs Playing Dead
data.detailed_description:
All art and code was made by a lowly human!

Fussy friends who can’t agree on what to play? Jump into a game where social skills, reflexes and strategy are all rewarded in different ways. During a twenty minute game, you will play as one of six different characters, each with different starting abilities and special talents. Find your favorite room and play its minigame to gain score. Those points will also improve your abilities- power, speed and health, which you will need to play the games at higher levels.

Also- watch out! Other players can come and interfere with your game, either helping or hindering you… keep an eye out for who is lurking around your room. And if you die in the game- well, the Host will punish you by turning you into a ghost- temporarily, of course. While a ghost, you can impact the progress of your fellow guests.

Just as you are starting to feel comfortable with the minigames in each room, the Host drags all the players into the Cellar and bids them to fight each other. Will you comply? You might convince everyone to stay peaceful and collect upgrades, but as soon as someone draws a weapon, you will have a fight on your hands. This is the perfect time to gang up on the player at the top of the standings table.

These two phases repeat three times, after which everyone compares scores and can be awarded for their achievements. Who comes out on top? Which canine will escape the mansion?

From the mind of ex-BioWare and ex-Metalhead developer Tobyn Manthorpe and his fourth game design.

data.short_description: Dogs Playing Dead is a competitive party game for up to 6 players that is equal parts boardgame, arcade and third-person shooter. Use your quirky character to explore each room of the mansion where diabolical minigames will test your skills. You need the most points to be able to leave the house!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6GB) or the AMD Radeon RX 580 (8GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: 6-core Intel i5/Ryzen 5, 3.0 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070/5070 or AMD Radeon RX 9070/7900 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS / SteamOS 3 or newer (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan compatible / Recent Mesa drivers
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS / SteamOS 3 or newer (64-bit)
